title: IQWiG General Methods
notes: Not DHT specific - A general HTA methods guide. Use it to shape the evidence plan and assessment approach.

title: #5 - Tips for DiGA Applicants
notes: Practical applicant tips. Use alongside the formal DiGA requirements when preparing a submission.

title: Guidelines for Economic Evaluations and Budget Impact Analyses
notes: Not DHT specific - Economic evaluation methods. Use to design cost-effectiveness and budget-impact evidence.

title: Testing of new examination and treatment methods
notes: Not DHT specific - A framework for testing new methods. Use to understand evidence expectations and possible evaluation routes.

title: Health Technology  Assessment  Framework:  Adaptation for Digital  Health Technology  Assessment
notes: DHT assessment criteria. Use as a checklist to identify evidence gaps before assessment.

title: Health Technology  Assessment  Framework:  Adaptation for Digital  Health Technology  Assessment: User  Guide
notes: Companion instructions for the DHT framework. Use to apply each criterion consistently.

title: Guide to the assessment of digital health technologies that incorporate artificial intelligence (AI)
notes: AI-focused assessment guidance. Use to address AI evidence, safety and governance considerations.

title: Evidence Standards Framework for Digital Health Technologies
notes: Evidence standards by DHT tier. Use to match the evidence plan to the product's function and risk. For local commissioning.

title: Digi-HTA Instructions for Companies
notes: Company instructions for Digi-HTA. Use to prepare the required information and submission.

title: Digi-HTA
notes: An overview and entry point for Digi-HTA. Use to understand the process and find application materials.

title: Digi-HTA Assessment Library
notes: Developer guidance: Published Digi-HTA assessments. Use as examples of how evidence is reviewed, not as fixed templates.

title: Digital Medical Devices: early management
notes: Early-access guidance for digital medical devices. Use to check PECAN eligibility and evidence needs.

title: Advance Digital Care (PECAN)
notes: An overview of the PECAN reimbursement route. Use to map eligibility, steps and key contacts.

title: Digital advance care: how to demonstrate clinical and organisational benefits
notes: Developer guidance: Explains how to show clinical and organisational benefit. Use to strengthen the PECAN evidence plan.

title: mHealthBelgium Validation pyramid
notes: Software specific - A staged validation and reimbursement pathway. Use to identify the level your product meets and what comes next.

title: Evidence framework for the assessment of health techologies
notes: Not DHT specific - A general health technology assessment framework. Use to structure the evidence case and adapt it for DHT.

title: Principes  d’évaluation de la  CNEDiMTS
notes: Assessment principles used by CNEDiMTS. Use the annexes to understand evidence expectations for digital devices.

title: DTAC
notes: NHS assurance criteria for digital products. Use as a checklist for clinical safety, data, security, interoperability and usability.

title: NICE Advice
notes: Early scientific advice from NICE.

title: NICE HealthTech Programme Manual
notes: NICE methods and processes for HealthTech.

title: NHS Innovation Service
notes: A support service connecting innovations with NHS guidance and partners. Use it to find the right pathway and next steps.

title: National Telemedicine Platform (PNT)
notes: National telemedicine platform information. Use to understand participation and service requirements.

title: Procedural Guidance for Joint Scientific Consultations (JSC) on Medical Devices (MD) and In Vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices (IVD)
notes: The procedure for joint scientific consultation. Use it to plan timelines, roles and dossier preparation.

title: Guidance on the HTACG recommendation for the selection of medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices for JCA
notes: Explains how devices are selected for EU joint clinical assessment. Use it to judge whether and when a product may be in scope.

title: Procedural Guidance for JCA medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices
notes: The procedure for EU joint clinical assessment. Use it to plan submission steps, responsibilities and timelines.

title: Guidance on filling in the joint clinical assessment (JCA) dossier template – Medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices
notes: Instructions for completing the JCA dossier template. Use when assembling the evidence package.

title: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2086 on joint clinical assessment of medical devices and in-vitro diagnostic medical devices
notes: Legally binding rules for device JCA. Use to confirm mandatory process and submission requirements.

title: Briefing document template for parallel HTACG/Expert Panels JSC for medical devices
notes: A template for parallel HTACG and expert-panel consultation. Use it to structure the briefing document.

title: Guidance for the selection of Medical Devices (MD) and In Vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices (IVD) for Joint Scientific Consultations (JSC)
notes: Selection criteria for device joint scientific consultation. Use to assess eligibility before applying.

title: Briefing document template for HTA-only Joint Scientific Consultation of In-vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices
notes: A template for HTA-only IVD consultation. Use it to prepare a complete, consistently structured briefing.

title: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/117 on joint scientific consultations on medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices
notes: Legally binding rules for device joint scientific consultations. Use to confirm required steps and timelines.

title: ASSESS DHT PRISM Tool
notes: Tool providing structured, lifecycle-based evaluation recommendations at all stages of DHT development. Also incorporates other ASSESS evaluation criteria such as Human Factors, Cybersecurity and Data Quality.

title: ASSESS DHT Outputs
notes: Results and outputs from the ASSESS DHT project.

title: EDiHTA Outputs
notes: Results and outputs from the EDiHTA project.
